# v11 platform exports

Generated from `concepts/v11/`; do not edit by hand.

- `web/`: favicon, PWA any/maskable icons, manifest icon fragments, and Apple touch icons.
- `android/`: adaptive icon XML, safe-zone foregrounds, monochrome icons, and legacy density fallbacks.
- `apple/`: iOS/iPadOS asset catalogs with 1024 px light, dark, and grayscale tinted variants.

All maskable and native artwork fits the stricter Android 66/108 safe square.
